<div class="card-body">
'''Kiffex''' is a [[Dark]] [[Location]] ([[System]]) from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">キフェックス</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
'''Light Side:''' <span lang="ja">ここに自分の宇宙船がちょうど2つだけいる場合には、合計戦闘力に＋2。</span>

'''Dark Side:''' <span lang="ja">ここに自分の宇宙船がちょうど2隻だけいる場合には、合計戦闘力に＋2、場に出ている「トニカ・シスターズ」の各数値とアイコンの数が2倍になる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Kiffex-PSA-89673873.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Kiffex.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Light uses the general counter 2つ; Dark uses the ship counter 2隻.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Kiffex]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
